title: The Prophecy of Fishers and Hunters
description: The Lord announces that he will send many fishers and hunters to track down the people from the mountains, hills, and clefts, to repay their sin and idolatry double because they have desecrated the land. The passage ends with a prayer in which Jeremiah acknowledges the Lord as his strength, and a prophecy that the nations from the ends of the earth will realize that the gods of their fathers are lies, and that they will know the Lord's hand and power and understand that his name is the Lord.
